example.trad: 他在一個國際組織工作。
example.pinyin: Tā zài yī ge guójì zǔzhī gōngzuò.
example.english: He works for an international organization.

example.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì fāzhǎn de hěn kuài.

包括.note: MOE reads this word bāo kuò, but many Taiwanese say bāo guā (MOE's main reading of 括 alone is guā, as in 括號 guā hào 'brackets').

example.pinyin: Fángzū bāokuò shuǐdiàn ma?

技術.note: Means skill or technique as well as technology; "tech" as an industry is usually 科技 (kē jì).

example.pinyin: Tā kāichē de jìshù hěn hǎo.

地區.note: A larger, somewhat formal word for an area; for 'a place' in everyday talk use 地方.

example.pinyin: Zhège dìqū chángcháng xiàyǔ.
example.english: It often rains in this area.

人民.note: Formal or political; heard mainly in news and speeches. In Taiwan, everyday talk uses 大家 or 民眾 (mín zhòng) instead.

example.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ yīnggāi zhàogù rénmín.
example.english: The government should take care of the people.

example.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng tán zhèngzhì.
example.english: I don't want to talk about politics.

example.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhǎodào le wǔqì.

造成.note: Usually with negative results: 造成問題 'cause problems', 造成麻煩 'cause trouble'.

example.pinyin: Dàyǔ zàochéng hěn duō wèntí.
example.english: The heavy rain caused a lot of problems.

example.pinyin: Zhè shì guójì diànhuà.

由於.note: Formal and mostly written. In speech people usually say 因為 yīn wèi.

example.trad: 由於下大雨，比賽取消了。
example.pinyin: Yóuyú xià dàyǔ, bǐsài qǔxiāo le.
example.english: Because of the heavy rain, the game was canceled.

參與.gloss: to take part in; to be involved
參與.note: 與 is yù here; it is yǔ when it means 'and, with'. For joining an event, everyday speech uses 參加 cān jiā.

example.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu cānyù zhè jiàn shì.

建立.hint: a relationship or system, not a building

example.trad: 他們建立了很好的關係。
example.pinyin: Tāmen jiànlì le hěn hǎo de guānxì.
example.english: They built a really good relationship.

example.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì quánguó dōu zhīdào le.
example.english: The whole country knows about this now.

項目.note: In Taiwan it means an item or category, or a sports event. A work 'project' is usually 專案 zhuān àn or 計畫 jì huà in Taiwan; the mainland uses 項目 for that.

example.pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài yǒu hěn duō xiàngmù.
example.english: This competition has a lot of events.

交易.note: Also a verb, 'to trade'. Common in 做交易 zuò jiāo yì 'to make a deal' and 網路交易 wǎng lù jiāo yì 'online transactions'.

example.pinyin: Wǒmen lái zuò ge jiāoyì.
Tā shì yuètuán de chéngyuán.
example.english: He's a member of the band.

example.trad: 結果不重要，過程才重要。
example.pinyin: Jiéguǒ bù zhòngyào, guòchéng cái zhòngyào.
example.english: The result doesn't matter; the process is what matters.

example.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de nèiróng hěn yǒuqù.
example.english: This book's content is really interesting.

攻擊.note: Taiwan (MOE) reads 擊 as jí; the mainland says gōng jī. Used for physical and verbal attacks.

example.pinyin: Bùyào gōngjí biérén.
Tōu dōngxi shì fànzuì.

權利.note: Sounds exactly like 權力 quán lì 'power, authority'; context tells them apart.

example.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu quánlì shuō bù.
example.english: You have the right to say no.

example.pinyin: Zuìjìn jīngjì bù tài hǎo.
example.english: The economy hasn't been great lately.

威脅.note: Also a noun meaning 'a threat'. MOE and mainland readings agree: wēi xié.

example.pinyin: Nǐ zài wēixié wǒ ma?

女性.note: A formal or written word (news, surveys, products). In conversation Taiwanese say 女生 nǚ shēng.

example.trad: 這家店有很多女性客人。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn yǒu hěn duō nǚxìng kèrén.
example.english: This shop has a lot of female customers.

專業.note: Also a noun for one's field of expertise. On the mainland it also means a college major; in Taiwan a major is usually 科系 kē xì or 主修 zhǔ xiū.

example.pinyin: Tā zuòshì hěn zhuānyè.

人物.hint: notable person, or in a story

example.pinyin: Tā shì hěn zhòngyào de rénwù.

顯示.note: For what a screen, test or study shows: 研究顯示 'research shows'. Showing something to someone is 給…看 gěi … kàn.

example.pinyin: Shǒujī xiǎnshì méiyǒu xùnhào.
example.english: The phone says there's no signal.

example.pinyin: Tā tíchū le yī ge hǎo wèntí.

教育.note: 教 is jiào here (teaching as a field); as the everyday verb 'to teach' it is jiāo: 教我 'teach me'.

example.trad: 台灣的父母很重視教育。
example.pinyin: Táiwān de fùmǔ hěn zhòngshì jiàoyù.
example.english: Parents in Taiwan care a lot about education.

example.pinyin: Shídài bù yīyàng le.

破壞.gloss: to destroy; to ruin; to damage
破壞.note: Also used for ruining a mood, plan or relationship, not only physical things.

example.pinyin: Bùyào pòhuài qìfēn la.

產生.gloss: to produce; to give rise to
產生.note: Slightly formal. Often with abstract things: 產生問題 chǎn shēng wèn tí 'cause problems', 產生興趣 chǎn shēng xìng qù 'become interested'.

example.pinyin: Zhèyàng huì chǎnshēng wèntí.
Zhèlǐ de huánjìng hěn hǎo.

命令.note: Also a verb: 命令我 mìng lìng wǒ 'order me around'. Ordering food is 點 diǎn, not 命令.

example.pinyin: Nǐ méiyǒu zīgé mìnglìng wǒ.
example.english: You have no right to order me around.

example.pinyin: Zhè shì tā zuì xīn de zuòpǐn.

價值.note: The price of something is 價錢 jià qián. 很有價值 hěn yǒu jià zhí means 'very valuable'.

example.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn yǒu jiàzhí.

以來.note: Comes after a time or event, often with 從 cóng: 從畢業以來 cóng bì yè yǐ lái 'since graduating'. 一直以來 yī zhí yǐ lái means 'all along'.

example.trad: 從畢業以來，我們就沒見過面了。
example.pinyin: Cóng bìyè yǐlái, wǒmen jiù méi jiànguò miàn le.
example.english: We haven't seen each other since graduation.

基本.note: 基本上 jī běn shàng 'basically' is very common in speech.

example.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ huì shuō jīběn de Yīngwén.
example.english: I can only speak basic English.

條件.note: Also someone's assets or qualifications: 他條件很好 'he's a good catch / well qualified'.

example.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī ge tiáojiàn.

管理.note: More formal than 管 guǎn. Spoken guán lǐ (tone sandhi).

example.pinyin: Tā zài guǎnlǐ yī jiā cāntīng.
Zhè shì wǒmen jiā de chuántǒng.

某.note: Used before a noun or measure word: 某人 'someone', 某天 'one day', 某些 'certain ones'. A little formal.

example.pinyin: Wǒ zài mǒu ge dìfāng kànguò tā.
Wǒ hěn xǐhuān Táiwān de wénhuà.
